description: This file defines a class 'CategoricalAccessor' for handling categorical properties of pandas Series within the PySpark pandas API, including methods for managing categories, ordering, and conversions.

classes.name: CategoricalAccessor
classes.description: Accessor class for categorical properties of pandas Series in PySpark pandas API, providing methods to access and modify categories, order, and codes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the accessor with a pandas Series, raising an error if the Series dtype is not categorical.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Gets or sets the categories of the categorical Series.

methods.name: ordered
methods.description: Indicates whether the categories are ordered.

methods.name: codes
methods.description: Returns a Series of codes representing the categorical data.

methods.name: add_categories
methods.description: Adds new categories to the existing categories.

methods.name: _set_ordered
methods.description: Internal method to set the ordered property of the categorical.

methods.name: remove_categories
methods.description: Removes specified categories from the categorical.

methods.name: remove_unused_categories
methods.description: Removes categories that are not used in the data.

methods.name: rename_categories
methods.description: Renames categories using list, dict, or callable.

methods.name: reorder_categories
methods.description: Reorders categories according to a new specified order.

methods.name: set_categories
methods.description: Sets new categories, possibly with reordering or renaming.
